1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R592)
Agentic Company OS, Agent-Era PM, Skill Meta-Evolution & Quota Pool
Q1: Self-Hosted AI Company Operating System?
• desplega-ai/agent-swarm (★1094, MIT, TypeScript):
Production multi-agent company OS by Desplega Labs
Coordinates specialist worker agents, task queues & tools
• Self-hosted MIT alternative to closed enterprise agent clouds
Q2: Agent-Native Project Management (Go + GHCR)?
• PerpetualSoftware/pad (★209, Apache-2.0, Go):
Project management built for humans + autonomous agents
Single Go binary / GHCR container (`perpetualsoftware/pad`)
• Replaces human-only Jira boards with agent-dispatchable specs
Q3: Evidence-Backed Meta-Skill Evolution (`task-observer`)?
• rebelytics/one-skill-to-rule-them-all (★3984, CC-BY-4.0):
Logs corrections & judgment calls (2,500+ obs across 87 skills)
Proposes small skill updates with evidence & reasoning
• Human-gated: nothing modifies a skill without explicit approval
Q4: Self-Hosted Enterprise AI Subscription Quota Pooling?
• gesta-run/subpool (★116, Apache-2.0, Go 1.24 + PG17):
Pools authorized AI subscriptions & API accounts across teams
Issues employee keys, tracks quota & exposes 1 unified API
• Zero-payload privacy: governs capacity without storing chats
2. End-to-End Enterprise Agentic Operating System, PM, Skill Flywheel & Quota Governance
Four-Pillar Architecture: Subpool Quota Plane ➔ Pad Agent PM ➔ Desplega Agent Swarm OS ➔ Task-Observer Meta-Skill
Pillar A: AI Company OS (desplega-ai/agent-swarm)
• Production Agentic OS: Full TypeScript orchestration runtime
(distinct from OpenAI's retired educational Swarm library)
• Role-Specialized Swarms: Coordinates coding, QA, ops &
research agents with shared workspace context & tool routing
• Self-Hosted Sovereignty: Runs inside corporate VPCs under
permissive MIT licensing with daily upstream evolution
• Scale Proof: ★1,094 stars & 182 forks
✓ Provides a self-hosted multi-department agent runtime
Pillar B: Agent-Era Project Mgmt (PerpetualSoftware/pad)
• Co-Designed for Humans & Agents: Treats AI coding agents
as first-class assignees alongside human engineers
• Structured Spec-to-Task Lifecycle: Breaks epics into
machine-actionable work items with clear acceptance criteria
• Lightweight Go Deployment: Ships as a fast Go binary and
official GHCR container (`ghcr.io/perpetualsoftware/pad`)
• License: Permissive Apache-2.0 License
✓ Bridges product specs directly into autonomous agent queues
Pillar C: Meta-Skill Flywheel (one-skill-to-rule-them-all)
• Task Observer Pattern: Watches how all other skills perform
across autonomous and human-led coding sessions
• Empirical Scale: Proven across 2,500+ logged observations,
87 evolved skills, 100+ contributors & 360+ closed PRs/issues
• Evidence-Backed Diffs: Every proposed skill update includes
concrete session evidence and rationale
• Strict Approval Gate: Nothing touches a skill without human OK
✓ Turns daily human corrections into compounding team skills
Pillar D: Quota Governance Plane (gesta-run/subpool)
• Modern Self-Hosted Stack: Go 1.24 + React 19 + PostgreSQL 17
deployed via Docker Compose under Apache-2.0
• Subscription & API Pooling: Combines authorized accounts
into shared capacity pools and issues employee-specific keys
• Quota Allocation & Audit: Real-time remaining quota tracking
and per-team budget governance behind one consistent API
• Privacy by Design: Never stores prompt/response content
✓ Eliminates idle per-seat subscription waste across teams
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R33-R592-AGENTSWARM-PAD-TASKOBSERVER-SUBPOOL · 45 Engineers @ $100.00/h)
Path A: Unpooled AI Seats + Cloud PM SaaS + Manual Skills
• Unpooled Subscriptions & PM SaaS: $3,380.00 / mo
• Manual Skill/Ticket/Quota Ops: 41.5 h/mo × $100/h = $4,150.00 / mo
• Overhead: 60% idle seat capacity while power users hit caps,
repeated agent mistakes & manual Jira-to-agent copy-paste
Path C: Self-Hosted OSS (Swarm + Pad + TaskObserver + Subpool)
• Docker Compose (Go 1.24 + PG17) Compute: $80.00 / mo
• Skill Approval & Pool Governance: 2.5 h/mo × $100 = $250.00 / mo
• Outcome: Pooled AI capacity, agent-native Pad tasking,
self-hosted Agent Swarm OS & evidence-backed skill evolution
Verified Closed-Form ROI & Governance Summary
• Monthly Net Savings: $7,200.00 / mo (-95.62%)
• Annualized Savings: $86,400.00 / yr
• License Gate: 100% Permissive (agent-swarm = MIT; pad &
subpool = Apache-2.0; one-skill-to-rule-them-all = CC-BY-4.0)
